contract: Consecutive account events at one instant retain compounded returns and period cash flows; drawdown includes initial capital.
genericValue: Every strategy can record an inception valuation and a post-fill valuation at the same instant. Reporting must include those costs independently of the trading rules.
publicBoundary: Financial calculation helpers, stable event ordering, neutral tests and changelog only. No private infrastructure, credentials, customer or strategy code.
retentionDecision: This change affects deterministic financial summaries after execution. It cannot change model requests, tool results, decisions, broker fills or historical actor evidence. No new model runs are warranted; re-analyse saved financial artifacts.
